requirements.description: VALID and response payload persist until transfer or reset.
Independent AW/W pairing, bounded outstanding work, no unsolicited/duplicate responses.
Per-byte masked writes at mapped aligned addresses; invalid writes have no effect.
AR snapshots register before same-edge write; invalid reads return SLVERR and zero.
Reset clears registers and responses, cancels partial and paired requests.
Product-specific bounded READY and response assertion under documented assumptions.

assumptions: Manager holds VALID and payload until actual handshake or reset.
One accepted outstanding write and one read; AW and W independent.
Finite write-half gap and response stalls as bounded in parameters.
Reset asserted before sample, deasserted synchronously; no asynchronous timing claim.
